# Psalm 40 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David.

**2** I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.

**3** He drew me up from the pit of destruction, out of the miry bog, and set my feet upon a rock, making my steps secure.

**4** He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and put their trust in the LORD.

**5** Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, who does not turn to the proud, to those who go astray after a lie!

**6** You have multiplied, O LORD my God, Your wondrous deeds and Your thoughts toward us; none can compare with You! I will proclaim and tell of them, yet they are more than can be told.

**7** In sacrifice and offering You have not delighted, but You have given me an open ear. Burnt offering and sin offering You have not required.

**8** Then I said, 'Behold, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written of me:

**9** I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.'

**10** I have told the glad news of deliverance in the great congregation; behold, I have not restrained my lips, as You know, O LORD.

**11** I have not hidden Your deliverance within my heart; I have spoken of Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not concealed Your steadfast love and Your faithfulness from the great congregation.

**12** As for You, O LORD, You will not restrain Your mercy from me; Your steadfast love and Your faithfulness will ever preserve me!

**13** For evils have encompassed me beyond number; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head; my heart fails me.

**14** Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me! O LORD, make haste to help me!

**15** Let those be put to shame and disappointed altogether who seek to snatch away my life; let those be turned back and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt!

**16** Let those be appalled because of their shame who say to me, 'Aha, Aha!'

**17** But may all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation say continually, 'Great is the LORD!'

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

- **40:3**: The 'pit of destruction' and 'miry bog' — images of Sheol-like entrapment. Rescue is dramatic: mud to rock, sinking to standing, old cry to new song.

— LOGOS
